case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Guests frequently praised the hotel's very convenient location by the metro, modern clean rooms, attentive staff and small in-room treats; several also reported good Wi‑Fi and quiet rooms at the back. Reported negatives varied: breakfast quality and space received both praise and criticism, one guest noted a sewage odor, another mentioned a noisy bathroom/WC door and an unwelcome bed configuration, and parking was described as expensive.

Open urgent inspections of plumbing, doors, and bed configurations; repair and update front desk SOP.
Conduct a service review of breakfast offerings, layout, staff training and communications; consider staggered times.
